# porkbun_glue_record (Resource)

Manages a glue record (host object) for a nameserver hostname under a domain. Use this resource when hosting a nameserver at a subdomain of the domain itself (e.g. `ns1.example.com`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porkbun_glue_record" "example" {
  domain    = "jiancodes.com"
  subdomain = "ns1"

  ips = ["192.0.2.1", "2001:db8::68"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain for the record being created.
- `ips` (Set of String) The IP addresses (IPv4 and/or IPv6) to associate with the host record.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain portion only (e.g. 'ns1' for ns1.example.com).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porkbun_glue_record.example <domain>_<subdomain>

terraform import porkbun_glue_record.example jiancodes.com_ns1
```
